22.16.explanation: Admit va deny dan keyin gerund kelishi mumkin: admitted scratching, denied breaking. A variantidagi to + asosiy fe’l noto‘g‘ri.

23.1.prompt: Odamni aniqlovchi olmoshni tanlang; faqat javobni yozing: The nurse ___ treated my ankle was very gentle. (who / which)
23.1.explanation: Nurse odamni bildiradi, shuning uchun berilgan variantlardan who mos keladi.

23.1.prompt: Faqat xato olmoshni almashtirib, butun gapni yozing. Who ishlating: Do you know the chef which won the prize?
answers: Do you know the chef who won the prize?
23.1.explanation: Chef odam bo‘lgani uchun which emas, who kerak. Who ergash gapning egasi ham hisoblanadi.

23.2.prompt: Faqat mos olmoshni yozing: The battery ___ powers this sensor is tiny. (which / who)
23.2.explanation: Battery narsa bo‘lgani uchun which qo‘llanadi. Bu aniqlovchi gapda that ham mumkin, ammo variantlarda which berilgan.

23.2.prompt: Bo‘shliqqa which yoki that dan mos keladiganini yozing: Is this the cable ___ connects the printer to the laptop?
23.2.explanation: Narsani aniqlovchi defining relative gapda which ham, that ham ishlatilishi mumkin.

23.3.prompt: Egalikni bildiruvchi bitta nisbiy olmoshni yozing: The athlete ___ coach retired is looking for a new trainer.
23.3.explanation: Murabbiy sportchiga tegishli ekanini whose coach birikmasi ko‘rsatadi.

23.3.prompt: Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: Have you met the artist ___ paintings hang in the lobby? (who / whose)
23.3.explanation: Paintings oldidan egalik bildiruvchi whose kerak: rasmlari vestibyulda osilgan rassom.

23.4.prompt: Joyni ifodalovchi where yoki which ni tanlang: We found a café ___ cyclists can refill their bottles. Faqat so‘zni yozing.
23.4.explanation: Ergash gap kafeda sodir bo‘ladigan harakatni bildiradi; where bu yerda at which ma’nosida.

23.4.prompt: Faqat bitta so‘zni tuzating va butun gapni yozing: This is the studio which we record our podcast. Which o‘rniga joy ravishini qo‘ying.
answers: This is the studio where we record our podcast.
23.4.explanation: We record our podcast gapiga joy ma’nosi kerak. Where — in which, ya’ni o‘sha studiyada degani.

23.5.prompt: Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: Do you recall the winter ___ the lake froze completely? (when / where)
23.5.explanation: Winter vaqtni bildiradi; shu davrda sodir bo‘lgan hodisa when bilan bog‘lanadi.

23.5.prompt: Vaqtni bildiruvchi nisbiy ravishni yozing: There was a period ___ our village had no electricity. (when / whose)
23.5.explanation: Period vaqt oralig‘i. When ergash gapni shu davr bilan bog‘laydi.

23.6.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Qaysi gapda zarur ega olmoshi bor? A) The dog that guards the warehouse belongs to Aziz. B) The dog guards the warehouse belongs to Aziz.
23.6.explanation: That guards fe’lining egasi bo‘lib kelgan. Ega vazifasidagi nisbiy olmoshni tushirib bo‘lmaydi.

23.6.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. To‘g‘ri savolni tanlang: A) Where is the parcel arrived this morning? B) Where is the parcel that arrived this morning?
23.6.explanation: Arrived fe’lining egasi that. Uni olib tashlash ikki gapni grammatik bog‘lovchisiz qoldiradi.

23.7.prompt: Faqat to‘ldiruvchi nisbiy olmoshini olib tashlab, gapni qayta yozing: The recipe that you recommended was delicious.
answers: The recipe you recommended was delicious.
23.7.explanation: That recommended fe’lining to‘ldiruvchisi; ega you bo‘lgani uchun that ni tushirish mumkin.

23.7.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Qaysi gapda nisbiy olmoshni tushirish mumkin? A) The scarf which I knitted is green. B) The scarf which covers the statue is green.
23.7.explanation: A da which to‘ldiruvchi, I esa ega. B da which covers fe’lining egasi, shuning uchun tushirilmaydi.

23.8.prompt: Faqat mos olmoshni yozing: Dr Evans, ___ trained in Canada, now runs our clinic. (who / that)
23.8.explanation: Vergul bilan ajratilgan qo‘shimcha ma’lumot gapida odam uchun who ishlatiladi; that ishlatilmaydi.

23.8.prompt: Faqat mos olmoshni yozing: Our new scanner, ___ arrived on Tuesday, is already in use. (which / that)
23.8.explanation: Non-defining relative gapda narsa uchun which kerak. That vergul bilan ajratilgan bunday gapga mos emas.

23.9.prompt: Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: Elena, ___ daughter is a violinist, invited us to a concert. (whose / who)
23.9.explanation: Daughter oldidan egalikni bildiruvchi whose ishlatiladi. Bu qo‘shimcha ma’lumotli gaplarda ham mumkin.

23.9.prompt: Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: Lisbon, ___ we spent our honeymoon, has steep streets. (where / which)
23.9.explanation: Ergash gapda Lisbon harakat sodir bo‘lgan joy. Where bu yerda in which ma’nosini beradi.

23.10.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Bir nechta ammam bor; faqat shifokor bo‘lganini ajratmoqchiman. A) My aunt who is a doctor works nights. B) My aunt, who is a doctor, works nights.
23.10.explanation: Qaysi amma ekanini aniqlash uchun who is a doctor zarur. Defining relative gap vergulsiz yoziladi.

23.10.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Bitta velosipedim bor; rangini qo‘shimcha ma’lumot sifatida aytaman. A) My bicycle which is yellow needs new tyres. B) My bicycle, which is yellow, needs new tyres.
23.10.explanation: Velosiped allaqachon aniq, rang esa qo‘shimcha ma’lumot. Non-defining gap ikki tomondan vergul bilan ajratiladi.

23.11.prompt: Rasmiy uslubdagi mos olmoshni yozing: The consultant with ___ we negotiated was patient. (whom / that)
23.11.explanation: Oldinga chiqarilgan predlogdan keyin odam uchun whom ishlatiladi: with whom. With that bu nisbiy tuzilmada mumkin emas.

23.11.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Nisbiy gapning oddiy va rasmiy shakllari qaysi juftlikda to‘g‘ri? A) the grant I applied for / the grant for which I applied B) the grant I applied for / the grant for that I applied
23.11.explanation: Oddiy uslubda predlog oxirda qolishi mumkin. Rasmiy shaklda predlog oldinga chiqsa, narsa uchun which kerak, that emas.

23.12.prompt: Butun oldingi fikrga ishora qiluvchi olmoshni tanlang: The team finished two days early, ___ surprised the client. (which / what)
23.12.explanation: Which bu yerda bitta otga emas, jamoaning ikki kun oldin tugatganiga ishora qiladi.

23.12.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. ‘The bus never arrived, which made us late.’ gapida which nimaga ishora qiladi? A) Avtobusning kelmaganiga. B) Faqat bus otiga.
23.12.explanation: Kechikishga avtobusning kelmagani sabab bo‘lgan. Which oldingi gapdagi butun vaziyatni anglatadi.

23.13.prompt: Who is qismini tushirib, fe’lni -ing shaklida saqlang. Butun gapni yozing: The technician who is testing the alarm needs silence.
answers: The technician testing the alarm needs silence.
23.13.explanation: Faol davomiy harakatni ifodalovchi who is testing qisqartirilganda testing qoladi.

23.13.prompt: Qisqartirilgan faol aniqlovchi uchun fe’l shaklini yozing: Passengers ___ to Rome should go to gate twelve. (travel)
23.13.explanation: Yo‘lovchilar harakatni bajaradi, shuning uchun -ing shakli kerak. Travelling Britaniya, traveling Amerika imlosi.

23.14.prompt: Which were qismini olib tashlab, butun gapni yozing: The samples which were collected yesterday are frozen.
answers: The samples collected yesterday are frozen.
23.14.explanation: Passiv aniqlovchi qisqartirilganda V3 qoladi: collected. Namunalar harakatni bajarmaydi, ular yig‘ilgan.

23.14.prompt: Qisqartirilgan passiv aniqlovchidagi fe’l shaklini yozing: The jewellery ___ from the gallery has been recovered. (steal)
23.14.explanation: Zargarlik buyumlari o‘g‘irlangan, shuning uchun steal ning V3 shakli stolen kerak; stealing faol ma’no beradi.

24.1.prompt: Faqat qavsdagi fe’lning kerakli shaklini yozing: Do you mind ___ the window? (close)
24.1.explanation: Mind fe’lidan keyin gerund, ya’ni -ing shakli keladi: mind closing.

24.1.prompt: Faqat xato fe’l shaklini tuzatib, butun gapni yozing: We avoid to park near the hospital.
answers: We avoid parking near the hospital.
24.1.explanation: Avoid dan keyin to-infinitive emas, -ing shakli kerak: avoid parking.

24.2.prompt: Faqat qavsdagi fe’lning kerakli shaklini yozing: The council agreed ___ the playground. (rebuild)
24.2.explanation: Agree fe’lidan keyin to-infinitive keladi: agreed to rebuild.

24.2.prompt: Faqat fe’l shaklini to‘ldiring: Did the climbers manage ___ the summit? (reach)
24.2.explanation: Manage to do something biror ishni uddalashni bildiradi. Shu sababli to reach kerak.

24.3.prompt: Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: The vet advised us ___ the cat indoors. (keep)
24.3.explanation: Advise + shaxs + to-infinitive qolipi qo‘llanadi: advised us to keep.

24.3.prompt: Faqat xato fe’l shaklini tuzatib, butun gapni yozing: The guard warned them staying away from the cliff.
answers: The guard warned them to stay away from the cliff.
24.3.explanation: Warn someone to do something qolipida shaxsdan keyin to-infinitive keladi: warned them to stay.

24.4.prompt: Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: The storm made the ferry ___ course. (change)
24.4.explanation: Faol gapdagi make + to‘ldiruvchi dan keyin to siz asosiy fe’l keladi: made the ferry change.

24.4.prompt: Faqat xato fe’l shaklini tuzatib, butun gapni yozing: Please let the soup to cool.
24.4.explanation: Let + to‘ldiruvchi + bare infinitive qolipi kerak. Cool oldidan to ishlatilmaydi.

24.5.prompt: Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: You must not ___ this switch with wet hands. (touch)
24.5.explanation: Modal must dan keyin, inkor gapda ham, fe’lning to siz asosiy shakli keladi.

24.5.prompt: Faqat xato fe’l shaklini tuzatib, butun savolni yozing: Could you to weigh this suitcase?
24.5.explanation: Could modal fe’lidan keyin weigh keladi; to weigh ishlatilmaydi.

24.6.prompt: Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: They left without ___ goodbye. (say)
24.6.explanation: Without predlogidan keyin fe’l gerund shaklida keladi: without saying.

24.6.prompt: Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: Are you looking forward to ___ your cousins? (see)
24.6.explanation: Look forward to birikmasidagi to predlogdir. Undan keyin infinitive emas, seeing kerak.

24.7.prompt: Maqsadni to + fe’l bilan ifodalang; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: We hired a van ___ the furniture. (move)
24.7.explanation: Furgon yollashning maqsadi mebellarni ko‘chirish. Maqsad to move infinitivi bilan beriladi.

24.7.prompt: Maqsadni to + fe’l bilan ifodalang; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: She set an alarm ___ the early train. (catch)
24.7.explanation: Budilnik qo‘yishdan maqsad poyezdga ulgurish; to catch shu maqsadni ko‘rsatadi.

24.8.prompt: Gap egasini gerund shaklida yozing: ___ regularly improves your stamina. (cycle)
24.8.explanation: Harakat gap egasi bo‘lganda gerund ishlatilishi mumkin: cycling. Cycle oxiridagi e tushadi.

24.8.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Qaysi gapda -ing shakli ega vazifasida? A) We practise drawing every evening. B) Drawing requires patience.
24.8.explanation: B gapida Drawing requires fe’lining egasi. A gapida drawing practise fe’lining to‘ldiruvchisi.

24.9.prompt: Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: We were relieved ___ the good news. (hear)
24.9.explanation: Relieved sifatidan keyin hisning sababini to-infinitive bilan berish mumkin: relieved to hear.

24.9.prompt: Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: Is this device safe ___ underwater? (use)
24.9.explanation: Safe sifatidan keyin to-infinitive keladi: safe to use — ishlatish xavfsiz.

24.10.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. ‘Quti juda og‘ir, uni ko‘tara olmayman’ ma’nosini tanlang: A) The box is too heavy for me to lift. B) The box is heavy enough for me to lift.
24.10.explanation: Too + sifat + to-infinitive ortiqcha daraja harakatga to‘sqinlik qilishini bildiradi. Enough esa yetarlilikni anglatadi.

24.10.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. ‘Narvon tomga yetadigan darajada uzun’ ma’nosini tanlang: A) The ladder is enough long to reach the roof. B) The ladder is long enough to reach the roof.
24.10.explanation: Enough sifatdan keyin keladi: long enough. Undan keyin to-infinitive ishlatiladi.

24.11.prompt: U endi tirnog‘ini tishlamaydi. Faqat mos shaklni yozing: He stopped ___ his nails. (biting / to bite)
24.11.explanation: Stop + -ing o‘sha harakatni to‘xtatishni bildiradi: tirnoq tishlashni bas qildi.

24.11.prompt: Sayyohlar yurishni vaqtincha to‘xtatib, xaritani tekshirishdi. Faqat mos shaklni yozing: The hikers stopped ___ the map. (checking / to check)
24.11.explanation: Stop to do boshqa harakatni bajarish uchun to‘xtashni bildiradi. Bu yerda yurish xaritani tekshirish uchun to‘xtatilgan.

24.12.prompt: Bajarilishi kerak bo‘lgan ishni eslatyapsiz. Faqat mos shaklni yozing: Remember ___ the plants before you leave. (watering / to water)
24.12.explanation: Remember to do hali bajarilishi kerak bo‘lgan ishni esdan chiqarmaslikni bildiradi.

24.12.prompt: Bolaligimdagi voqea xotiramda. Faqat mos shaklni yozing: I will never forget ___ the ocean for the first time. (seeing / to see)
24.12.explanation: Forget doing o‘tmishda sodir bo‘lgan voqeani unutish bilan bog‘liq. Never forget seeing — ko‘rganimni hech qachon unutmayman.

24.13.prompt: Yechim sifatida usulni sinab ko‘rishni tavsiya qiling: If the sauce is too sour, try ___ a little honey. (adding / to add) Faqat shaklni yozing.
24.13.explanation: Try doing bir usulni sinab, natijasini ko‘rishni bildiradi; bu yerda asal qo‘shish tajriba sifatida taklif qilinmoqda.

24.13.prompt: Urinish bo‘lgan, lekin ish amalga oshmagan. Faqat mos shaklni yozing: I tried ___ the fallen tree, but it was too heavy. (lifting / to lift)
24.13.explanation: Try to do qiyin ishni bajarishga urinishni bildiradi. Daraxtni ko‘tarish bu yerda muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘lgan.

24.14.prompt: Avvalgi, hozir yo‘q odatni ifodalang; faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: I used to ___ stamps, but I no longer do. (collect)
24.14.explanation: Used to + asosiy fe’l o‘tmishdagi odatni bildiradi. Undan keyin collecting emas, collect keladi.

24.14.prompt: Hozirgi ko‘nikkanlikni ifodalang; faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: The baker is used to ___ before dawn. (work)
24.14.explanation: Be used to birikmasi ko‘nikkanlikni bildiradi. Bu yerdagi to predlog bo‘lgani uchun working kerak.

24.15.prompt: Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: It took me a month to get used to ___ on the left. (drive)
24.15.explanation: Get used to ko‘nikish jarayonini bildiradi; to dan keyin -ing shakli keladi.

24.15.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Yangi sharoitga ko‘nikish ma’nosidagi to‘g‘ri gapni tanlang: A) The puppy is getting used to its new home. B) The puppy is getting use to its new home.
24.15.explanation: To‘g‘ri birikma get used to. Undan keyin gerund ham, its new home kabi ot birikmasi ham kelishi mumkin.

24.16.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Olmosh bilan to‘g‘ri gapni tanlang: A) Please turn down it. B) Please turn it down.
24.16.explanation: Turn down ajraladigan phrasal verb. To‘ldiruvchi olmosh bo‘lsa, it fe’l va yuklama orasida turadi.

24.16.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. A) I came across it in the attic. B) I came it across in the attic.
24.16.explanation: Come across — tasodifan topmoq — ajralmaydigan birikma. It across dan keyin keladi.

24.17.prompt: Faqat kerakli predlogni yozing: Who is responsible ___ locking the laboratory? (for / to)
24.17.explanation: Responsible sifati for predlogi bilan keladi: responsible for doing something.

24.17.prompt: Faqat kerakli predlogni yozing: The hotel apologised ___ the delay. (for / at)
24.17.explanation: Apologise for biror holat yoki ish uchun uzr so‘rashni bildiradi. Bu yerda kechikish uchun uzr so‘ralgan.

24.18.prompt: Ishni mutaxassis bajargan. Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: We had the kitchen tiles ___ last week. (replace)
24.18.explanation: Have + narsa + V3 xizmatni boshqaga bajartirishni bildiradi: had the tiles replaced.

24.18.prompt: Xizmatni boshqaga bajartirish qolipida faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: Can I get these documents ___ today? (print)
24.18.explanation: Get + narsa + V3 qolipida printed kerak. Savol hujjatlarni chop ettirish imkonini so‘raydi.

25.1.prompt: Ikki muqobil tanlovni bog‘lang. Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: You may pay by card ___ use cash. (and / but / or)
25.1.explanation: Or muqobil tanlovlarni bildiradi: karta bilan yoki naqd to‘lash mumkin.

25.1.prompt: Qarama-qarshi fikrni ulang; faqat bog‘lovchini yozing: The suitcase looks small, ___ it holds a lot. (and / but / or)
25.1.explanation: Tashqi kichik hajm va katta sig‘im qarama-qarshi qo‘yilmoqda; but shu zidlikni bildiradi.

25.2.prompt: Faqat mos bog‘lovchini yozing: The flight was cancelled ___ fog covered the runway. (because / because of)
25.2.explanation: Fog covered the runway ega va fe’lli gap bo‘lgani uchun because kerak; because of dan keyin ot birikmasi keladi.

25.2.prompt: Since sabab ma’nosida ishlatilgan gapni tanlang. Faqat A yoki B ni yozing: A) Since the shop is closed, we will order online. B) We have ordered online since March.
25.2.explanation: A gapida since — do‘kon yopiqligi sababli degani. B gapida since vaqtning boshlanish nuqtasini bildiradi.

25.3.prompt: Faqat mos iborani yozing: The museum closed early ___ a power failure. (because / because of)
25.3.explanation: A power failure ot birikmasi, shu sababli uning oldidan because of ishlatiladi.

25.3.prompt: Faqat mos iborani yozing: Several trains were delayed ___ heavy snowfall. (due to / since)
25.3.explanation: Heavy snowfall ot birikmasi. Due to + ot birikmasi sababni bildiradi; sabab bildiruvchi since esa ega-fe’lli gap bilan keladi.

25.4.prompt: Natijani bildiruvchi bog‘lovchini tanlang: The battery was flat, ___ the car would not start. (so / because) Faqat so‘zni yozing.
25.4.explanation: Birinchi qism sabab, ikkinchisi natija. So avtomobilning yurmaganini natija sifatida bog‘laydi.

25.4.prompt: Faqat mos iborani yozing: The factory installed better filters. ___, the air nearby became cleaner. (As a result / For example)
25.4.explanation: Havoning tozalanishi filtrlar o‘rnatilishining natijasi. As a result shu natijani ko‘rsatadi.

25.5.prompt: Faqat mos bog‘lovchini yozing: ___ the route was steep, the children reached the top. (Although / Despite)
25.5.explanation: The route was steep ega-fe’lli gap. Although undan oldin kelib, kutilmagan qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi.

25.5.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. To‘g‘ri gapni tanlang: A) Even though the shop was busy, but the assistant remained calm. B) Even though the shop was busy, the assistant remained calm.
25.5.explanation: Even though bilan boshlangan zidlov ergash gapdan keyin shu vazifa uchun yana but qo‘shilmaydi.

25.6.prompt: Faqat fe’l shaklini yozing: Despite ___ a headache, Karim finished the rehearsal. (have)
25.6.explanation: Despite dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi: despite having a headache.

25.6.prompt: Faqat yetishmayotgan bitta so‘zni yozing: In spite ___ the noise, the baby stayed asleep.
25.6.explanation: To‘liq birikma in spite of. Undan keyin the noise kabi ot birikmasi kelishi mumkin.

25.7.prompt: Qarama-qarshi fikrni bog‘lang; faqat mos so‘zni yozing: The tickets were expensive. ___, every seat was sold. (Nevertheless / Therefore)
25.7.explanation: Qimmatlikka qaramay hamma joy sotilgan. Nevertheless kutilmagan zid natijani bildiradi.

25.7.prompt: Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: The instructions looked simple. ___, assembling the desk took hours. (However / Moreover)
25.7.explanation: Oddiy ko‘ringan yo‘riqnoma bilan uzoq davom etgan yig‘ish jarayoni zid. However qarama-qarshi fikrni kiritadi.

25.8.prompt: Ikki kishining qarama-qarshi odatini bog‘lang: I save every receipt, ___ my brother throws them away. (whereas / because) Faqat so‘zni yozing.
25.8.explanation: Whereas ikki turli odatni taqqoslab, qarama-qarshi qo‘yadi; sabab bildirmaydi.

25.8.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Qaysi gapda while vaqtni emas, qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi? A) While I was washing up, the phone rang. B) The north is dry, while the south is humid.
25.8.explanation: B gapida while ikki hududning iqlimini taqqoslaydi. A gapida esa hodisa qachon bo‘lganini ko‘rsatadi.

25.9.prompt: Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: The tunnel was ___ narrow that two cars could not pass. (so / such)
25.9.explanation: Narrow sifatidan oldin so ishlatiladi: so + sifat + that + natija.

25.9.prompt: Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: The actor spoke ___ softly that we could barely hear him. (so / such)
25.9.explanation: Softly ravish; so + ravish + that qolipi uning darajasi keltirib chiqargan natijani bildiradi.

25.10.prompt: Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: It was ___ an exciting final that nobody left early. (so / such)
25.10.explanation: An exciting final ot birikmasi. Such + a/an + sifat + ot + that qolipi ishlatiladi.

25.10.prompt: Faqat mos so‘zni yozing: They gave us ___ useful directions that we found the cabin immediately. (so / such)
25.10.explanation: Useful directions sifat va ko‘plikdagi otdan iborat. Such qo‘llanadi, ammo ko‘plik ot oldidan a/an kelmaydi.

25.11.prompt: Faqat yetishmayotgan so‘zni yozing: We left quietly in order ___ wake the patients. (not to / to not to)
25.11.explanation: Inkor maqsad in order not to + fe’l bilan beriladi: bemorlarni uyg‘otmaslik uchun.

25.11.prompt: Faqat kerakli so‘zni yozing: The archivist wore gloves so as ___ protect the old letters. (to / for)
25.11.explanation: Maqsad bildiruvchi to‘liq birikma so as to. Undan keyin protect asosiy shaklda keladi.

25.12.prompt: Faqat mos iborani yozing: I emailed the diagram ___ the engineer could check it before the meeting. (so that / in order to)
25.12.explanation: Keyingi qismning o‘z egasi va modal fe’li bor: the engineer could. Bunday maqsad gapini so that bog‘laydi.

25.12.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Grammatik jihatdan to‘g‘ri maqsad gapini tanlang: A) We lowered the shelf so that the children could reach it. B) We lowered the shelf so that the children to reach it.
25.12.explanation: So that dan keyin ega va tuslangan fe’l kerak. Could reach shu vazifani bajaradi; to reach mustaqil kesim emas.

25.13.prompt: Kelajak haqida gap: faqat to‘g‘ri fe’l shaklini yozing: I will message you as soon as the plane ___. (lands / will land)
25.13.explanation: Kelajak ma’nosidagi as soon as vaqt ergash gapida odatda Present Simple ishlatiladi, will qo‘yilmaydi.

25.13.prompt: Kutishning tugash chegarasini ko‘rsating; faqat bog‘lovchini yozing: Do not unplug the device ___ the update is complete. (until / after)
25.13.explanation: Not ... until yangilanish tugamaguncha qurilmani uzmaslikni bildiradi. Until kutilayotgan chegara vaqtini belgilaydi.

25.14.prompt: Oldindan ehtiyot chorasi nazarda tutilgan. Faqat iborani yozing: Save an offline copy ___ the internet fails during the presentation. (in case / if)
25.14.explanation: In case ehtimoliy muammo yuz berishidan oldin tayyorlanishni bildiradi: internet uzilib qolishi ehtimoliga qarshi nusxa saqlanadi.

25.14.prompt: Yordamni faqat muammo yuz bergandagina chaqiring. Faqat bog‘lovchini yozing: Call the technician ___ the screen goes black. (if / in case)
25.14.explanation: If shartni bildiradi: ekran o‘chsa, shundan keyin texnik chaqiriladi. Bu oldindan ehtiyot chorasi emas.

25.15.prompt: Ikkalasida ham yo‘qligini bildiring; faqat bog‘lovchini yozing: Neither the cabin ___ the tent has electricity. (or / nor)
25.15.explanation: Neither ... nor juftligi ikki narsani ham inkor qiladi. Neither bilan nor moslashadi.

25.15.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Qaysi variantda ikkala juft bog‘lovchi to‘g‘ri? A) Both tea or juice are available; choose either tea and juice. B) Both tea and juice are available; choose either tea or juice.
25.15.explanation: Both ... and ikkalasini qo‘shadi. Either ... or esa ikkita variantdan birini tanlashni bildiradi.

25.16.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Parallel tuzilmani tanlang: A) The course teaches not only coding but also drawing. B) The course teaches not only coding but also to draw.
25.16.explanation: Not only va but also dan keyingi qismlar bir xil grammatik shaklda bo‘lishi kerak: coding va drawing.

25.16.prompt: Faqat yetishmayotgan so‘zni yozing: The new pump is not only quieter ___ also cheaper.
25.16.explanation: Juft bog‘lovchi not only ... but also. Quieter va cheaper parallel qiyosiy sifatlardir.

25.17.prompt: Qo‘shimcha dalil kiriting; faqat mos so‘zni yozing: The hostel is close to the station. ___, breakfast is included. (Moreover / However)
25.17.explanation: Ikkinchi gap yana bir afzallikni qo‘shmoqda. Moreover qo‘shimcha dalilni kiritadi.

25.17.prompt: Misolni kiriting; faqat mos iborani yozing: Some metals are very light. ___, aluminium is widely used in aircraft. (For instance / As a result)
25.17.explanation: Aluminium oldingi umumiy fikrga misol bo‘lmoqda. For instance misol keltirish uchun ishlatiladi.

25.18.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Standart yozma ingliz tilida tinish belgilarini to‘g‘ri tanlang: A) The deadline was tight; however, we submitted the report on time. B) The deadline was tight, however, we submitted the report on time.
25.18.explanation: However ikki mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan ulay olmaydi. Uning oldidan nuqtali vergul, keyin vergul qo‘yish to‘g‘ri.

25.18.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. To‘g‘ri tinish belgili variantni tanlang: A) The ferry was full, therefore, we waited for the next one. B) The ferry was full. Therefore, we waited for the next one.
25.18.explanation: Therefore oldidan nuqta qo‘yish mustaqil gaplarni to‘g‘ri ajratadi. A variantida ikki mustaqil gap faqat vergul bilan noto‘g‘ri ulangan.

26.1.prompt: Faqat mos fe’lni yozing: The box of spare cables ___ under the counter. (is / are)
26.1.explanation: Eganing bosh so‘zi birlikdagi box. Of spare cables ichidagi ko‘plik kesimni o‘zgartirmaydi.

26.1.prompt: Faqat mos fe’lni yozing: The windows in the upstairs bedroom ___ replacing. (need / needs)
26.1.explanation: Asosiy ega windows ko‘plikda. Bedroom birligi ta’sir qilmaydi; need ishlatiladi.

26.2.prompt: Faqat mos fe’lni yozing: Somebody ___ left a scarf on the bus. (has / have)
26.2.explanation: Somebody grammatik jihatdan birlikdagi olmosh, shuning uchun has bilan moslashadi.

26.2.prompt: Faqat mos fe’lni yozing: Does everything ___ correctly now? (work / works)
26.2.explanation: Everything birlik bo‘lgani uchun yordamchi does ishlatilgan. Does dan keyingi asosiy fe’l work shaklida qoladi.

26.3.prompt: Umumiy ma’noda gapiring. Faqat the yoki artikl kerak bo‘lmasa zero deb yozing: ___ patience is essential when training animals.
26.3.explanation: Patience umumiy ma’nodagi sanalmaydigan ot. Bu yerda artikl ishlatilmaydi.

26.3.prompt: Muayyan sabr nazarda tutilgan. Faqat a, the yoki zero dan birini yozing: ___ patience you showed yesterday impressed me.
26.3.explanation: You showed yesterday qismi aynan qaysi sabr haqida gap ketayotganini aniqlaydi. Shuning uchun the kerak.

26.4.prompt: Faqat the yoki artikl kerak bo‘lmasa zero deb yozing: They sailed along ___ Danube last summer.
26.4.explanation: Daryo nomlari odatda the bilan ishlatiladi: the Danube.

26.4.prompt: Britaniya ingliz tilida mahbuslik holati nazarda tutilgan. Faqat the yoki zero deb yozing: He spent three years in ___ prison for robbery.
26.4.explanation: In prison mahbus sifatida qamoqda bo‘lishni bildiradi va artiklsiz ishlatiladi. Muayyan bino nazarda tutilsa the prison bo‘lishi mumkin.

26.5.prompt: Material ma’nosi nazarda tutilgan. Faqat mos variantni yozing: This sculpture is made of ___. (glass / a glass)
26.5.explanation: Glass material sifatida sanalmaydigan ot. A glass esa bitta ichimlik stakanini bildiradi.

26.5.prompt: Ikkita porsiya ichimlik buyurtma qiling; faqat mos variantni yozing: Could we have ___, please? (two coffees / two coffee)
26.5.explanation: Coffee odatda sanalmaydi, lekin kafeda porsiya yoki finjon ma’nosida sanaladigan ot bo‘lib, two coffees deyiladi.

26.6.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Neytral uslubdagi tabiiy sifat tartibini tanlang: A) a small round mirror B) a round small mirror
26.6.explanation: Odatdagi sifat tartibida hajm shakldan oldin keladi: small — hajm, round — shakl.

26.6.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Neytral uslubdagi tabiiy sifat tartibini tanlang: A) a leather red Italian bag B) a red Italian leather bag
26.6.explanation: Bu sifatlarga odatdagi tartib rang, kelib chiqish, material: red, Italian, leather.

26.7.prompt: Faqat mos sifatni yozing: The instructions were so ___ that nobody could assemble the shelf. (confused / confusing)
26.7.explanation: Yo‘riqnoma chalkashlikni keltirib chiqaradi, shu sababli confusing. Confused esa chalkashgan kishining holatini bildiradi.

26.7.prompt: Faqat mos sifatni yozing: Were you ___ by the sudden announcement? (surprised / surprising)
26.7.explanation: Odamning his-tuyg‘usi surprised bilan ifodalanadi. Surprising hayratga sabab bo‘luvchi narsa yoki holatga tegishli.

26.8.prompt: Oddiy darajalanuvchi sifat bilan standart birikmani tanlang; faqat variantni yozing: The room was ___. (very warm / absolutely warm)
26.8.explanation: Warm darajalanuvchi sifat; very uning darajasini kuchaytiradi. Absolutely odatda mutlaq yoki kuchli chegaraviy sifatlar bilan keladi.

26.8.prompt: Kuchli ma’noli sifat bilan odatiy kuchaytirgichni tanlang: After the overnight hike, we were ___ exhausted. (absolutely / very) Faqat so‘zni yozing.
26.8.explanation: Exhausted juda qattiq charchagan degan kuchli ma’noli sifat. Standart birikma absolutely exhausted.

26.9.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. ‘Faqat Maya taklifni rad etdi; boshqalar qabul qildi’ ma’nosi qaysi? A) Only Maya rejected the offer. B) Maya only rejected the offer.
26.9.explanation: Only ega Maya oldida tursa, boshqa odamlarni istisno qiladi. Fe’l oldida tursa, odatda harakatning o‘zini cheklaydi.

26.9.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. ‘He almost dropped the vase.’ nimani bildiradi? A) U vazaning deyarli hammasini tashladi. B) U vazani tushirib yuboray dedi, lekin tushirmadi.
26.9.explanation: Almost dropped harakat sodir bo‘lishiga sal qolganini bildiradi. Almost bu yerda buyum miqdorini emas, harakatni o‘zgartiradi.

26.10.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. To‘g‘ri bilvosita savolni tanlang: A) Could you tell me if does this bus stop at the stadium? B) Could you tell me if this bus stops at the stadium?
26.10.explanation: If dan keyin oddiy gap tartibi kerak: this bus stops. Does bilan savol inversiyasi ishlatilmaydi.

26.10.prompt: Ha/yo‘q mazmunidagi bilvosita savolni to‘ldiring. Faqat bog‘lovchini yozing: Do you know ___ the pharmacy accepts cards? (whether / that)
26.10.explanation: Noaniq ha/yo‘q ma’lumotini so‘rashda whether yoki if ishlatiladi. Berilgan variantlardan whether mos.

26.11.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. A) Can you explain why the machine keeps stopping? B) Can you explain why does the machine keep stopping?
26.11.explanation: Bilvosita wh-savolda why dan keyin ega va kesim oddiy tartibda keladi; does bilan inversiya qilinmaydi.

26.11.prompt: Faqat so‘z tartibidagi xatoni tuzatib, butun savolni yozing: Do you know when is the next performance?
answers: Do you know when the next performance is?
26.11.explanation: Bilvosita savol qismida ega the next performance is fe’lidan oldin keladi.

26.12.prompt: Faqat qisqa tasdiqlovchi savol qismini yozing; inkor yordamchini qisqartiring: The printer works now, ___?
26.12.explanation: Tasdiq Present Simple gapiga inkor tag qo‘shiladi. Printer uchun it, works uchun does yordamchisi kerak: doesn’t it.

26.12.prompt: Faqat tag qismini yozing; inkor yordamchini qisqartiring: Your parents have arrived, ___?
26.12.explanation: Tasdiq Present Perfect gapiga haven’t they qo‘shiladi. Parents ko‘plikda, shuning uchun they ishlatiladi.

26.13.prompt: Faqat tag qismini yozing: The driver did not see the sign, ___? Haydovchi erkak.
26.13.explanation: Inkor Past Simple gapidan keyin tasdiq yordamchi did keladi. Erkak haydovchi uchun he ishlatiladi.

26.13.prompt: Faqat tag qismini yozing: These berries are not poisonous, ___?
26.13.explanation: Inkor are not gapidan keyin tasdiq are they keladi. Ko‘plikdagi berries o‘rnida they ishlatiladi.

26.14.prompt: ‘Men ham’ deb qo‘shiling. Javobni So bilan boshlang: ‘I can juggle.’ — ‘___.’
26.14.explanation: Tasdiq gapga qo‘shilishda so + yordamchi/modal + ega keladi. Can modal fe’li takrorlanadi.

26.14.prompt: ‘Men ham bormaganman’ deb qo‘shiling. Javobni Neither bilan boshlang: ‘I have never visited Iceland.’ — ‘___.’
26.14.explanation: Never inkor ma’nosini beradi. Inkor fikrga qo‘shilish uchun neither + have + I ishlatiladi.

26.15.prompt: Bilish ma’nosidagi holatni ifodalang. Faqat mos shaklni yozing: I ___ exactly what you mean. (understand / am understanding)
26.15.explanation: Understand bu ma’noda holat fe’li. Oddiy hozirgi zamondagi understand tabiiy shakl hisoblanadi.

26.15.prompt: Hozir bajarilayotgan faol tekshirishni ifodalang. Faqat mos shaklni yozing: The chef ___ the soup to check the salt. (tastes / is tasting)
26.15.explanation: Taste bu yerda ataylab tatib ko‘rish harakati. Shu sababli hozirgi davomiy zamon is tasting ishlatiladi.

27.1.prompt: Future Continuous bilan to‘ldiring; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing, qisqartma ishlatmang: At this time on Saturday, we ___ over the Alps. (fly)
27.1.explanation: Kelajakdagi aniq paytda davom etadigan harakat will be + -ing bilan ifodalanadi: will be flying.

27.1.prompt: Future Continuous bilan to‘ldiring; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing, qisqartma ishlatmang: At ten tomorrow, the technicians ___ the new cameras. (install)
27.1.explanation: Ertaga soat o‘nda jarayon davom etadi. Tasdiq shakli will be installing bo‘ladi.

27.2.prompt: Future Continuous inkor shaklini yozing; faqat bo‘shliqni to‘ldiring, qisqartma ishlatmang: I ___ the car at lunchtime tomorrow, so you can borrow it. (not / use)
27.2.explanation: Inkor Future Continuous will not be + -ing bilan tuziladi: will not be using.

27.2.prompt: Berilgan gapni Future Continuous inkor shakliga aylantiring. Butun gapni yozing, qisqartma ishlatmang: The band will be rehearsing at noon.
answers: The band will not be rehearsing at noon.
27.2.explanation: Will dan keyin not qo‘shiladi, be rehearsing esa saqlanadi. Inkor aynan kelajakdagi davomiy jarayonga tegishli.

27.3.prompt: Gapni Future Continuous ha/yo‘q savoliga aylantiring. Butun savolni yozing: The children will be camping this weekend.
answers: Will the children be camping this weekend?
27.3.explanation: Savolda will egadan oldinga chiqadi. Be camping egadan keyin qoladi.

27.3.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. To‘g‘ri Future Continuous savolini tanlang: A) Will you be staying at the lodge tonight? B) Will you staying at the lodge tonight?
27.3.explanation: Future Continuous savolida will + ega + be + -ing kerak. B variantida be tushib qolgan.

27.4.prompt: Qavsdagi fe’lni Future Continuous savolida qo‘llang. Bo‘shliqlardagi so‘zlarni tartib bilan bitta javob qilib yozing: Where ___ you ___ during the renovation? (sleep)
27.4.explanation: To‘liq savol Where will you be sleeping during the renovation? bo‘ladi. Birinchi bo‘shliq will, ikkinchisi be sleeping.

27.4.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. Future Continuous wh-savolini tanlang: A) What equipment you will be testing tomorrow? B) What equipment will you be testing tomorrow?
27.4.explanation: Wh-iboradan keyin will egadan oldin keladi: What equipment will you be testing? Bu bevosita savol tartibi.

27.5.prompt: Future Perfect bilan to‘ldiring; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing, qisqartma ishlatmang: By September, Aisha ___ her driving course. (complete)
27.5.explanation: Kelajakdagi muddatgacha tugaydigan ish will have + V3 bilan beriladi: will have completed.

27.5.prompt: Future Perfect bilan to‘ldiring; faqat bo‘shliqni yozing, qisqartma ishlatmang: By midnight, the rescuers ___ the missing hikers. (find)
27.5.explanation: Find fe’lining V3 shakli found. Future Perfect tasdiq qolipi will have found bo‘ladi.

27.6.prompt: Future Perfect inkor shaklini yozing; qisqartma ishlatmang, faqat bo‘shliqni to‘ldiring: By Monday, the paint ___ completely. (not / dry)
27.6.explanation: Future Perfect inkori will not have + V3. Dry fe’lining V3 shakli dried.

27.6.prompt: Gapni Future Perfect inkor shakliga aylantiring. Butun gapni yozing, qisqartma ishlatmang: They will have sold all the tickets by dawn.
answers: They will not have sold all the tickets by dawn.
27.6.explanation: Will dan keyin not qo‘yiladi. Have sold saqlanib, tonggacha barcha chiptalar sotilib bo‘lmasligini bildiradi.

27.7.prompt: Gapni Future Perfect ha/yo‘q savoliga aylantiring. Butun savolni yozing: The snow will have melted by April.
answers: Will the snow have melted by April?
27.7.explanation: Future Perfect savolida will egadan oldin, have + V3 esa undan keyin keladi.

27.7.prompt: Faqat A yoki B ni yozing. To‘g‘ri Future Perfect savolini tanlang: A) Will the guests have eaten by the time we arrive? B) Will the guests have ate by the time we arrive?
27.7.explanation: Have dan keyin V3 kerak. Eat fe’lining V3 shakli eaten; ate esa Past Simple shakli.

27.8.prompt: Tasdiq qisqa javob yozing: ‘Will you be leading the tour tomorrow?’ — ‘___.’ O‘zingiz haqingizda I bilan javob bering.
27.8.explanation: Future Continuous qisqa javobida faqat will yordamchisi takrorlanadi: Yes, I will. Be leading takrorlanmaydi.

27.8.prompt: Inkor qisqa javob yozing: ‘Will the students be using this lab tonight?’ — ‘___.’ They ishlating; qisqartma mumkin.
27.8.explanation: Students o‘rnida they keladi. Inkor qisqa javob No, they will not yoki No, they won’t shaklida bo‘ladi.

27.9.prompt: How many bilan boshlang. Faqat A yoki B ni yozing: A) How many chapters will you have edited by Tuesday? B) How many chapters you will have edited by Tuesday?
27.9.explanation: Bevosita wh-savolda will egadan oldin turadi. Have edited kelajakdagi muddatgacha tugallangan ishni so‘raydi.

27.9.prompt: Future Perfect wh-savolini to‘ldiring; bo‘shliqlardagi so‘zlarni tartib bilan yozing: Which cities ___ she ___ by the end of the tour? (visit)
27.9.explanation: To‘liq savol Which cities will she have visited by the end of the tour? Birinchi bo‘shliqqa will, ikkinchisiga have visited qo‘yiladi.

27.10.prompt: Tasdiq qisqa javob yozing: ‘Will Jamila have submitted her thesis by June?’ — ‘___.’ She ishlating.
27.10.explanation: Future Perfect savoliga qisqa javob will bilan beriladi: Yes, she will. Have submitted qaytarilmaydi.

27.10.prompt: Inkor qisqa javob yozing: ‘Will you have saved enough by winter?’ — ‘___.’ I ishlating; qisqartma mumkin.
27.10.explanation: Future Perfect qisqa javobida asosiy yordamchi will saqlanadi. Inkor shakli will not yoki won’t.

27.11.prompt: Soat uchda safar hali davom etadi. Faqat mos iborani yozing: At three, we ___. (will be travelling / will have arrived)
27.11.explanation: O‘sha vaqtdagi davom etayotgan jarayon Future Continuous bilan beriladi. Will have arrived esa yetib kelish tugaganini bildiradi.

27.11.prompt: Hisobot soat beshgacha to‘liq tayyor bo‘ladi. Faqat mos iborani yozing: By five, I ___ the report. (will be writing / will have written)
27.11.explanation: Tugallangan natija va yakun muddati Future Perfect ni talab qiladi: will have written.

27.12.prompt: ‘Payshanbagacha tayyorlab bo‘lamiz’ ma’nosini bering. Faqat predlogni yozing: We will have prepared the contract ___ Thursday. (by / until)
27.12.explanation: By ish tugallanishining eng kech muddatini bildiradi. Until esa odatda shu vaqtgacha davom etishni ko‘rsatadi.

27.12.prompt: Kelajakdagi vaqt ergash gapini to‘ldiring; faqat mos fe’lni yozing: By the time the audience ___, we will have tested every microphone. (arrives / will arrive)
27.12.explanation: By the time dan keyingi kelajak ma’noli vaqt gapida Present Simple ishlatiladi: arrives. Asosiy gap Future Perfect da.

27.13.prompt: O‘tmishdagi amalga oshmagan rejani was going to bilan bering. Faqat bo‘shliqni yozing: I ___ a picnic, but the forecast changed. (organise)
27.13.explanation: Was going to + fe’l o‘tmishda rejalashtirilgan ishni bildiradi. Ob-havo prognozi o‘zgargani uchun reja amalga oshmagan.

27.13.prompt: O‘tmish nuqtasidan keyingi voqeani bildiring; faqat modal fe’lni yozing: In 2015, nobody knew that this small company ___ become a global brand. (will / would)
27.13.explanation: 2015-yildagi o‘tmish nuqtasidan kelajakni ifodalash uchun would ishlatiladi. Bu future in the past shakli.
